This '''vessel''' was used by [[Regenald Hanniper Snopps III]] during stay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A customized [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[AQ-5 Waveskimmer|waveskimmer]], it measured fourteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and had large windows that a standard military spec waveskimmer. It required a crew of three to operate effectively, as well as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] to handle the two light [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. Twenty passengers could ride in the vessel, and there was room for a [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]] of cargo.

Snopps took the vessel, along with the ship's [[Unidentified waveskimmer captain|captain]] and a squad of six [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] on a journey to visit [[the wreck]], a derelict [[Alien/Legends|alien]] spacecraft of unknown origin that was a popular tourist destination on the planet.
